entryId.description: Order entry id. Required if `productId` is not provided. Use for entry modification. Cannot be provided along with `productId`.

productId.description: Id of the product added to the order. Required if `entryId` is not provided. Cannot be provided along with `entryId`.

quantity.description: Quantity of the products added to the order. When set to `0` then such entries are removed from the order.
